{{Planned article|A reference matrix for Odyssey Engineer modifications, including which Engineers provide each suit or handheld-weapon modification.}}

'''Odyssey Engineer Modifications''' is planned as a lookup page for on-foot modification availability. It will connect Odyssey modifications to the Engineers who provide them and to practical suit or weapon planning notes.
